reddit.detail: RETIRED 2026-07-20. Reddit blocks unauthenticated JSON: old.reddit.com 403 and www.reddit.com 403, tested live with a browser User-Agent. No REDDIT_CLIENT_ID exists anywhere in the repo, so no request this system can make will succeed. The endpoint fix in 9bc2849 (old.reddit + raw_json=1) was correct code against a door that is shut. Reviving this source requires a registered OAuth app and oauth.reddit.com — not a code change here.

value.regime_read: NQ and ES diverging (one up, one down/flat) — rotation underway, regime shifting. Tech-led longs are suspect.
value.narrative:
Macro backdrop —
[2026-07-27] US economic state (FRED):
  Growth: real GDP 2.1% (q/q ann)
  Inflation: CPI 3.23% YoY | core CPI 2.25% | core PCE 2.89% (Fed target 2%)
  Labor: unemployment 4.2%
  Rates: fed funds 3.63% | 10Y 4.71% | 10Y-2Y 0.36% (NORMAL)
  Consumer: UMich sentiment 44.8 | VIX 18.7

---
Recent market action shows a divergence between NQ and ES, with the Nasdaq-100 (NQ) trending higher while the S&P 500 (ES) consolidates. This divergence suggests rotation dynamics are at play, particularly in tech-heavy sectors. The lead-lag analysis indicates that the current regime is warning of potential shifts, making it prudent to be cautious with long positions and maintaining a narrow probability bias. Volume profile data highlights key levels around 7439 for ES and 28520 for NQ, indicating areas where significant buying or selling pressure has occurred. The upcoming FOMC meeting on July 29th is a critical event that may influence market sentiment, necessitating adjustments in position sizing and stop placement. Given the mixed signals from both lead-lag and volume profile, our directional bias leans towards long-the-dip with a probability of ~65%, but this could be invalidated if either ES falls below 7430 or NQ drops below 28500.
